name: @kira905/dsh-router-toolkit
description: Controlled verbs for an orchestrator-style DSH main session: it issues commands but never executes them. A distilled minimal skeleton (message delivery with two gates, three health checks, an agent-preset template, vision-gap ranking, a hand-off header compressor, an optional vision pointer on digest rows, a mechanical per-workstream digest, and stale-attention bookkeeping that fails open). Zero third-party runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: node test/run-self-test.mjs && node test/run-unit-tests.mjs && node test/test-router-act.mjs
